cases.mode: Historical replay research prototype - the frozen Sentinel/B2 models execute live on stored real ECMWF IFS ENS forecast states; not a live or NCMRWF feed
cases.selection_rule:
(fixed before any demo output was viewed): from the existing 2022 replay set,
the earliest seed-drawn RANDOM case in each season (JF, MAM, JJAS, OND), plus the earliest
existing hidden-bust STRESS case (selected by verification in the v1 replay build; labelled
"not representative").

cases.demo_role: Hidden-bust stress case - selected by verification, NOT representative
cases.selection_note: Hidden-bust stress case: 21 hidden-bust region-days at Day 3-7 (selected by verification only; not representative)

run.mode: Historical replay research prototype - the frozen Sentinel/B2 models execute live on stored real ECMWF IFS ENS forecast states; not a live or NCMRWF feed

model.calibration: isotonic regression fitted on validation (2021) predictions only, then frozen
model.learner: XGBoost CPU hist (one shared model: region, lead day, season + forecast-state features)
model.selection_note: No candidate feature group beat B2 on 2021 validation AUPRC, so the validated Sentinel uses B2's inputs and its probabilities equal B2's. The UI shows this as measured.
model.pending: Current demo uses the completed available research feature set; wind/MSLP extension is pending (download stopped, incomplete; not used anywhere in this demo).
model.alert_threshold_definition: Sentinel probability giving a 10% false-alarm rate on VALIDATION (2021)

priority_formula.formula: score = p_bust * 0.5**((lead_day-1)/H) * evidence_weight + B * max(0, p_bust - p_B2)
priority_formula.note: Product triage rule; weights are design choices, not fitted or validated constants.

attribution.method: TreeSHAP on the Sentinel booster (log-odds, before isotonic calibration)
attribution.note: TreeSHAP contributions (log-odds, before isotonic calibration). They describe what the model used; they are associations, not physical causes.

reveal.reference: ERA5 (verification reference analysis; not perfect truth)

comparison.note: The expected signature is evaluated against the actual fingerprint only when the region-day verified as a bust.

memory_update.note: Verified outcomes become analogue candidates for initialisations at or after their valid time (causal memory). The persisted research store already contains them; nothing is re-trained.
